scripts.build: npm run build:kakomonn-reader && npm run build:kakomonn-sync && npm run build:congratulations
scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:kakomonn-live-site && npm run test:kakomonn-live-open && npm run test:kakomonn-live-sync
scripts.test:local: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:repository-naming && npm run test:static-cache-policy && npm run test:kakomonn-config && npm run test:kakomonn-sync-launcher && npm run test:open-kakomonn && npm run test:release-script && npm run test:live-sync-script && npm run test:kakomonn-reader && npm run test:kakomonn-sync && npm run test:congratulations
scripts.test:kakomonn-reader: npm run build:kakomonn-reader && node --test kakomonn-reader/tests/build_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/correct_feedback_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/runtime_recycle_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/swipe_navigation_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/userscript_metadata_test.mjs && es-check es2020 kakomonn-reader/kakomonn-reader.user.js
scripts.test:congratulations: npm run check:congratulations && npm run build:congratulations && node congratulations/tests/smoke.mjs && node congratulations/tests/browser.mjs
scripts.check:congratulations: node --check congratulations/shared/experience-runtime.js && node --check congratulations/celebration-selection.mjs && node --check congratulations/router.js && node --check congratulations/vite.config.js && node --check congratulations/scripts/inject-experience-runtime.mjs && node --check congratulations/tests/smoke.mjs && node --check congratulations/tests/browser.mjs && node --check congratulations/tests/production.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:kakomonn-sync && node kakomonn-reader/tests/smoke_test.js && node kakomonn-reader/tests/time_limit_smoke_test.js && node kakomonn-reader/tests/webkit_smoke_test.js && node kakomonn-sync/tests/dashboard_e2e_test.js
scripts.deploy:kakomonn-sync: npm run test:kakomonn-sync && npm run test:kakomonn-dashboard && node --use-system-ca node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --config kakomonn-sync/wrangler.jsonc && npm run test:kakomonn-sync-production && npm run test:kakomonn-live-dashboard
scripts.deploy:congratulations: npm run test:congratulations && node --use-system-ca node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --config congratulations/wrangler.jsonc && npm run test:congratulations-production
